selection_basis: Camera identity and both-class support, without selecting by model scores. Both held-out roles have substantial existing N/P support before this correction. The v1_16 reference-selection camera stays on the training side.
outer_evaluation_scope: One cross-camera development holdout. It is not the final external independent test and not evidence of all-camera stability.
external_media_policy: All externally reserved test media remain outside these150 units; the19 pool-external audit entries are not interchangeable with the23-item primary external test manifest.
synthetic_descendants: Inherit the reference parent camera role. No synthetic training is authorized in this specification.
length_policy: Compute the shared cap once from the selected release before benchmark. Benchmark determines affordability, not an unrecorded change of training exposure. If the shared cap is below2 or the quote is unaffordable, revise and record the design before training. Inner selection chooses the earliest best complete traversal; refit uses exactly that traversal count.
authorization: No experiment signature, GPU rental, model training, uploads or paid generation is granted by this role file.
